metadata.title: feat(mcp): add GraphQL to MCP translation support
metadata.author: crivetimihai

description:
> **Note:** This PR was re-created from #2989 due to repository maintenance. Your code and branch are intact. @crivetimihai please verify everything looks good.

## Summary

- Add experimental GraphQL-to-MCP translation with automatic schema introspection, dual-mode operation (CLI bridge + direct registration), feature flags, configuration, documentation, and ADR-0041
- Extend the tool model with `GRAPHQL` integration type and GraphQL-specific fields (`graphql_operation`, `graphql_variables_mapping`, `graphql_field_selection`, `graphql_operation_type`)
- Add `translate_graphql.py` CLI bridge that introspects GraphQL endpoints and exposes discovered queries/mutations as MCP tools via HTTP/SSE

## Test plan

- [x] Config loads with correct defaults: `mcpgateway_graphql_enabled=False`
- [x] Config schema JSON contains all 5 new GraphQL fields
- [x] `config.py` passes flake8
- [x] All existing unit tests pass
- [x] Unit tests for `translate_graphql` module included

commits.message:
feat: add GraphQL to MCP translation support

Add experimental GraphQL-to-MCP translation with automatic schema
introspection, dual-mode operation (CLI bridge + direct registration),
feature flags, configuration, documentation, and ADR-0041.

- Add GraphQL feature flags to config.py (disabled by default)
- Add translate_graphql.py CLI bridge with introspection discovery
- Extend schemas.py with GRAPHQL integration type and field validators
- Add GraphQL columns to tools table (db.py + Alembic migration)
- Update tool_service.py for GraphQL field persistence
- Add .env.example, Helm values, configuration docs sections
- Create user-facing docs (graphql-services.md)
- Create ADR-0041: GraphQL to MCP Translation
- Regenerate config.schema.json
- Add unit tests for translate_graphql module

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Mihai Criveti
